title: PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration
abstract: arXiv:2610.14855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. translated_title: PEAM：面向个性化、高效且自主移动网络配置的设备端通信代理
translated_abstract: 智能手机上紧凑型大语言模型的日益普及正在实现自主的设备端决策，例如新兴的移动GUI代理。然而，许多移动决策，例如用户切换应用或网络连接条件变化时的网络配置，必须满足严格的时延约束以保持用户体验。在本文中，我们提出PEAM，一个基于设备端大语言模型的通信代理，能够自主生成可在毫秒内执行的个性化网络配置规则。具体而言，PEAM首先使用从人工标注的真实用户数据构建的数据集对设备端LLM进行微调，以将通信知识集成到本地模型中。随后，PEAM在两个阶段中运行。在规则生成阶段（在设备空闲时执行，例如夜间），PEAM批量分析历史网络配置记录，并进行跨批次反思以整合一致的
tldr: PEAM是一个基于设备端大语言模型的通信代理，通过真实用户数据微调和两阶段规则生成机制，自主生成可在毫秒内执行的个性化移动网络配置规则。
en_tdlr: PEAM is an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized mobile network configuration rules executable within milliseconds, via fine-tuning on real user data and a two-phase rule generation mechanism.
